name: visualization
description: Draw anything a reader has to look at to understand — 39 editorial diagram types and the quantitative chart forms — as one self-contained HTML file with inline SVG. Merges a comprehensive diagram system with a measured data-visualisation method: the form comes from the data's job, multi-series colour goes through a runnable perceptual validator rather than taste, charts are held to zero-baseline and shared-scale honesty rules, and twelve verifier scripts ship inside the skill so the agent that draws can check its own output and read an exit code. Successor to diagram-design by Cathryn Lavery, whose 39 layout grammars, connector rules and import pipeline it keeps intact.
